title: EyeClean per-frame index: patches/index.json (eyeclean.process/1)
description: Every processed frame, and every tracked eye in it. Paths are relative to the output directory. data_window is [x0, y0, x1, y1) in full-frame pixels. Additional fields may appear within version 1.

track.description: stable eye track id within the clip

eye.description: which eye of its face (left/right as seen by the tracker)

status.description: repaired: pixels inside the hard support were edited; untouched: the eye is bit-exact

reasons.description: why the gate decided as it did (e.g. no_reflection_detected, fill_network_value_12px)

patch.description: signed correction EXR (R,G,B = output - source, working space)

replacement.description: RGBA EXR, straight alpha, A = hard support

mask.description: EXR channels hard, feather, synth, selected, abstained
